title: Infinite coordinate clopens and their affine closed complement
statement: Let k be a field and I an infinite set in the scheme universe [def-pc-scheme]. Put R = I → k, let e_i be the coordinate idempotents, J the ideal generated by all e_i, X = Spec R, Z = Spec(R/J), and s:Z → X the quotient morphism. Write W_i = D(e_i) and U = ⋃_i W_i. Then s is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], its range is complementary to U, the open immersion U → X [def-weil-open-immersion] is not quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and the W_i are pairwise disjoint nonempty clopen subschemes whose inclusions into X are closed immersions.

source.place: def-pur-flasque-support, step 5: infinite product of fields, coordinate clopens and their closed complement.

proof.text: For each coordinate idempotent e_i, e_i(1-e_i)=0 and e_i+(1-e_i)=1, so D(e_i) is clopen. Surjectivity of the quotient ring map makes Spec(R/J) → Spec R a closed immersion, whose range is V(J). A prime contains J exactly when it contains every e_i, so V(J) is the complement of the union of D(e_i).

The prime pulled back from the zero ideal of k by evaluation at i lies in D(e_j) exactly when i=j. Thus every coordinate piece is nonempty. Distinct coordinate idempotents have zero product; primality shows their basic opens are disjoint. A clopen open-subscheme inclusion is also a closed immersion.

If the union inclusion were quasi-compact, its inverse image of the compact affine base would be compact, and hence its image U would be compact. The coordinate basic opens then admit a finite subcover of U. Choose an index outside this finite set; its evaluation prime belongs to U and to none of that finite subfamily, a contradiction.

proof_origin.place: def-pur-flasque-support, step 5: infinite product of fields, coordinate clopens and their closed complement.

lean.statement:
theorem pair_properties [Infinite I] :
    IsClosedImmersion (closedInclusion k I) ∧
      IsCompl (Set.range (closedInclusion k I)) (Set.range (openPart k I).ι) ∧
      ¬ QuasiCompact (openPart k I).ι ∧
      (∀ i : I, IsClosedImmersion (piece k I i).ι ∧ Nonempty (piece k I i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j : I ↦ Disjoint (piece k I i) (piece k I j))
